_comment: stateloom MCP registration. Replace BOTH absolute paths before use. STATELOOM_PROJECT_FILE must be absolute — a relative path resolves against the MCP process's own cwd and silently diverges from the web designer's. Drop STATELOOM_BRIDGE_URL to run standalone (disk only, no live canvas). SMCRAFT_* twins are optional; the server reads STATELOOM_* first and falls back to them.

stateloom-from-source._comment: Alternative: run a local checkout instead of the published package.
